title: FHP Job Brief
description: The canonical representation of a job opportunity in the Fair Hiring Protocol. Companies must complete all required fields. Vague or exclusionary requirements are not permitted. Salary ranges are mandatory.

fhp_version.description: The FHP spec version this job brief conforms to.

job_id.description: A globally unique, opaque identifier for this job posting. UUID v4.

company_id.description: The FHP-issued identifier for the posting company.

expires_at.description: When this job brief should be deactivated. Required to prevent ghost listings.

title.description: A plain-language job title. Must describe the actual work, not a marketing label. Titles like 'Rockstar Developer' or 'Ninja' are rejected at validation.

role_summary.description: A plain-text description of the role, its responsibilities, and the team context. Must describe work, not candidate personality traits.

skills_required.description: The skills the role requires, each tagged as must-have or nice-to-have. All skill references must resolve in the FHP Skill Ontology.

requirement_level.description: must_have skills are scored against the constraint satisfaction threshold. nice_to_have skills contribute to the preference alignment score.

minimum_proficiency.description: The minimum acceptable proficiency level on the FHP scale. Must be justifiable by the role's actual responsibilities.

context.description: Optional explanation of why this skill is required and how it will be used. Improves matching quality and candidate experience.

salary.description: Salary range. Both minimum and maximum are required. Ranges must be honest — posting a £40k–£200k range to obscure the real budget is a compliance violation.

includes_bonus.description: If true, the range includes variable/bonus pay. Fixed base must be disclosed separately in notes.

work_mode.description: The work arrangement for this role.

flexible_days.description: Whether the on-site days are fixed or flexible.

location.description: Where the work will be performed. Required even for remote roles (for tax/legal jurisdiction context).

region.description: ISO 3166-2 region/state code or free text.

remote_regions_permitted.description: For remote roles: the countries/regions from which candidates may work. Empty means unrestricted.

team_context.description: Optional but strongly encouraged. Helps candidates make informed decisions.

reports_to_role.description: The role this position reports to — described by function, not title.

direct_reports.description: Number of direct reports, if any.

tech_stack_summary.description: A brief description of the tools, platforms and languages in active use.

process.description: The hiring process the candidate will go through. Transparency here is a compliance requirement.

is_async.description: True if candidates can complete this stage on their own schedule.

response_sla_days.description: Maximum days within which the company commits to respond to any applicant at any stage. Governs ghosting SLA enforcement.

prohibited_filters.description: FHP compliance assertions. The company attests that none of these filters are applied in evaluating candidates against this brief.

no_degree_requirement.description: Company confirms no educational credential is required unless it is a legal or regulatory requirement of the role.

no_institution_preference.description: Company confirms no preference for candidates from specific universities or institutions.

no_graduation_year_filter.description: Company confirms years-since-graduation is not used as a filter.

no_unpaid_work.description: Company confirms no unpaid work (including 'take-home tasks' exceeding 2 hours) is required.
